# BoothLedger

> Professional photo booth software for events. Canon DSLR support, custom templates, instant SMS/email sharing, cloud management & AI effects.

BoothLedger is a Windows photo booth application designed for professional event photographers and photo booth operators. It supports Canon DSLR cameras, custom multi-photo templates, direct dye-sublimation printing, and instant sharing via SMS, email, and QR codes. The software includes two AI engines for creative effects like magazine covers, movie posters, artistic transformations, custom prompts and AI video.

- [AI Video Booth](https://boothledger.com/ai-video-booth): Turn booth photos or AI photo transformations into 5-10 second AI videos (image-to-video) delivered to guests by QR while the booth keeps running - 12 built-in effects (Animate, Style + Animate, Transformation Reveal), custom video prompts, per-event spend limits, from $0.25 per clip in AI credits on the Pro plan
- [Pricing](https://boothledger.com/pricing): Basic EUR 12/month (standard and photo strip events); Pro EUR 35/month (every event type plus the AI photo booth); 30-day free trial includes all of Pro
- [Mirror Booth](https://boothledger.com/mirror-booth): Mirror booth software for interactive photo booth experiences
- [Green Screen Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/green-screen-photo-booth): Green screen and AI background removal features
- [Newspaper Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/newspaper-photo-booth): Newspaper photo booth software that turns each guest into a custom A4 front-page newspaper with an editable headline, names and date, printed full-size on-site. "On This Date" mode lets a guest enter a birthday (or any date from 1900 on) and writes the front page from that day — headline, story, captions and classified ads — for $0.03 of AI credit per page, in 8 languages
- [Colouring In Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/colouring-photo-booth): Colouring in photo booth software that converts guest photos into printable A4 colouring pages with AI line art - faces stay recognisable, pages print on plain paper on-site, and guests keep a digital copy
- [Photo Mosaic](https://boothledger.com/photo-mosaic): Guests turn the event album into a photo mosaic from their gallery link — pick any photo or upload a picture/logo and every booth photo becomes a tile. Included free with every gallery.
- [Photo Booth Data Capture](https://boothledger.com/photo-booth-data-capture): GDPR-compliant guest data capture — collects emails and phone numbers with an explicit Yes/No opt-in at the booth (nothing pre-ticked, photo sent either way), consent timestamped, 12-month auto-expiry, one-click erasure, EU hosting, per-event on/off and custom wording, CSV export per event and account-wide. Included in every plan.
- [Pay-Per-Use Photo Booth](https://boothledger.com/pay-per-use-photo-booth): Pay-per-use (self-service, unattended) photo booth software for pubs, nightclubs, tourist attractions, Santa's grottos and shopping centres - guests pay by card (Nayax VPOS Touch, pulse mode) or coin before each session, credits returned if a session is cancelled before the first photo; triggers for WLED, Shelly and Home Assistant lights; signed webhooks to Zapier and Make; local control API; QR code payments by phone through Stripe (3.7% fee plus VAT where it applies). Pro plan and free trial.
- [Photo Booth Integrations Guide](https://boothledger.com/photo-booth-integrations-guide): Step-by-step setup for BoothLedger integrations - session moments, triggers for WLED lights / Shelly relays / Home Assistant, signed webhooks to Zapier and Make (with signature verification code), the local control API, pay to play (card reader, coins, QR payments by Stripe, packages, PIN protection) and payments, fees and invoices. PDF: https://boothledger.com/downloads/boothledger-integrations-guide.pdf
- [Photo Booth CRM](https://boothledger.com/photo-booth-crm): Photo booth CRM and booking software built into BoothLedger, included with every plan - quotes customers book online with a card deposit (Stripe or Revolut), invoices with PDF and reminders, a private booking page per customer (pay balance, add extras, choose a template with their wording, upload artwork), staff scheduling with WhatsApp job requests, staff hours and payroll, CSV import and branding. One click turns a booking into a BoothLedger event with the client's design applied, synced to the photo booth.
- [iPad Photo Booth App](https://boothledger.com/ipad-photo-booth-app): BoothLedger for iPad and iPhone - Canon DSLR tethering over USB, direct USB printing to DNP and Citizen dye-sub printers on an M-series iPad (iPadOS 16+), AirPrint on any iPad, AI effects, boomerangs, custom templates and cloud galleries, on the same account as the Windows app. Launching soon on the App Store.

## Key Features

- Canon DSLR camera integration with live view
- AI styles, custom prompts and AI video
- Custom multi-photo templates
- Direct dye-sublimation printing
- SMS, email, and QR code sharing
- Boomerang and GIF capture
- Cloud sync via BoothLedger Cloud
- BoothLedger Share (https://boothledgershare.photoboothguys.ie): guest share station web app for any tablet, phone or laptop — guests browse the event gallery and share by SMS, email or QR code (guests download on their own phone via the QR link); slideshow with music; same account as the booth. Cloud mode for venues with internet, or at no-internet venues the tablet joins the same Wi-Fi network as the booth PC, which serves the current event's photos locally. The ecosystem is three apps: BoothLedger (desktop, at the event) + BoothLedger Cloud (backend/storage/config) + BoothLedger Share (guest-facing).
- Photo booth CRM: bookings linked to booth events, quotes with deposits, invoices, customer booking pages, staff scheduling
- Offline mode with automatic sync
- Mirror booth support
- Green screen and AI backgrounds
- Newspaper front-page templates with full A4 printing
- "On This Date" birthday newspapers: the guest enters a date and AI writes that day's front page, printed with their photo
- Video guestbook recording
- Integrations: pay to play (card/coin payment per session), lighting and relay triggers, signed webhooks (Zapier, Make), local control API
